howm.autoLinkOnPaste.description: Convert a single HTTP/HTTPS URL, file URL, or backslash-delimited absolute Windows path pasted into Markdown to a link. Web links use the page title or selected text; file links use the filename.
howm.notesDirectory.description: Notes folder. Leave empty to use howm in the workspace. Supports absolute paths, ~/, and workspace-relative paths.
howm.filenamePattern.description: Filename pattern for new notes. Adds a sequence number if the file already exists.
howm.defaultTitle.description: Default title for new notes. Selected text takes precedence. Set to an empty string to start with a blank title.
howm.template.description: Template for new notes. Supports {title}, {date}, {time}, and {body}.
howm.maxFileSizeKB.description: Maximum size of Markdown files to index (KB).
howm.calendarWeekStart.description: First day of the calendar week. Changes apply immediately to the visible calendar.
howm.todos.dueSoonDays.description: Number of days before a deadline (!) to use the due-soon color in Todos and Schedule. 0 means the due date only. Deadlines use the overdue color starting the next day. Customize colors with howm.todoDueSoonForeground, howm.todoOverdueForeground, and howm.scheduleTodayForeground in workbench.colorCustomizations.
howm.onThisDay.enabled.description: Show notes from this day in previous years, grouped by year.
howm.similarNotes.enabled.description: Show notes with content similar to the current note.
howm.similarNotes.maxResults.description: Maximum number of similar notes to display.
howm.similarNotes.autoRefresh.descriptio: Automatically refresh similar notes when switching or editing notes.
howm.relatedPassages.enabled.description: Show past passages related to the text near the cursor.
howm.relatedPassages.maxResults.descript: Maximum number of related passages to display.
howm.relatedPassages.contextLines.descri: Number of lines before and after the cursor to use as the query. Short queries are expanded within the same section.
howm.relatedPassages.windowLines.descrip: Number of nonempty body lines per search passage. Changes rebuild the passage index.
howm.relatedPassages.windowStep.descript: Number of lines to advance between search passages. Limited to windowLines.
howm.relatedPassages.minQueryLength.desc: Minimum query length after removing Markdown formatting and whitespace.
howm.relatedPassages.autoRefresh.descrip: Automatically refresh related passages 500 ms after cursor movement or edits.
howm.calendarWeekStart.sunday.descriptio: Sunday first (Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat)
howm.calendarWeekStart.monday.descriptio: Monday first (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun)
